items: 2 tbsp brown sugar or palm sugar

steps: Cut the chicken breast fillets into small bite-sized pieces. Cut the vegetables into small pieces as well, except for the eggplants, as they brown quickly. It's better to steam the broccoli beforehand.

Heat oil (not olive oil) in a large pan, add the green curry paste and combine it with a little coconut milk. Add the chicken and stir-fry it, then add the green chili peppers and vegetables and cook them together according to their cooking time. Add sugar (to taste), soy sauce, fish sauce, and deglaze everything with coconut milk. I prefer a thick sauce, so I add the coconut milk gradually until I reach the desired consistency.
Now add the lime leaves and let it simmer for about 3-5 minutes, then add the Thai sweet basil leaves. DO NOT continue cooking, and serve immediately with Thai jasmine rice.
